text: {"A": {"fidelity": 4, "omitted": [], "added": [], "mistranslated": ["ù noc kixob (a covering/crown of thorns) -> 'a garment of thorns' (loosely rendered)", "ca tu Zitah -> 'he departed' (uncertain reading; the sense is doubtful)"]}, "B": {"fidelity": 3, "omitted": ["ca tu Zitah (he left/departed after speaking)"], "added": ["the younger of two brothers studying in Paris is being described (meta claim not supported by this page)", "and it is not far off"], "mistranslated": ["utial tan apactic ù lobil à belob ca à hach okte à kebanob (so that you, seeing the evil of your ways, might weep for your sins) -> 'I have been watching your wicked ways, waiting for you to weep'", "tan úpactic û xotol û kin (awaiting the end of his life) -> 'watching for the rising of the sun'", "ù noc kixob (covering/crown of thorns) -> 'bearing the marks of the lashes'", "ù hach yatal tin Uol ù Zatal Uinicoob (great grief in my heart at the loss of men) -> 'the great love in my heart for the loss of men'", "pectzil (rumor/report) -> 'shame'"]}, "better": "A", "comment": "A is complete and closely follows the Maya, while B gets several key phrases wrong: the end of life, the thorns, and grief rendered as love."}

{"A": {"fidelity": 3, "omitted": [], "added": [], "mistranslated": ["lolob la kilob (your wicked companions) -> 'those wicked pleasures of yours'", "à caab ù hahil à tħan à culpachticoob (pledge truly to forsake them) -> 'Speak the truth and confess them'", "cichcelemil (beauty) -> 'youthful vigor'; ɔibolan (coveted) -> 'praised'", "tu nukul tu betah (he decreed it justly) -> 'for all that you did'", "the brother's great hope strengthened the sick man's heart -> brother's own 'heart strengthened by great hope'"]}, "B": {"fidelity": 3, "omitted": [], "added": ["to visit him"], "mistranslated": ["u lohul ù chucanob (redemption of captives) -> 'redemption of all others'", "kahez ɔocan à manzic u yanalob àzab nohob (remember you have already come through other, greater ones) -> 'after you endure it, other and greater things will come'", "ti alakoob (by companions) -> 'by the women'", "ú tħibete hach chacan tiob layob catulob t maniebe (plainly resembling the two who came before) -> 'appearing clearly to both of them who were passing the night there'", "alabolal (hope) -> 'faith'"]}, "better": "tie", "comment": "Both translations cover the whole page and each has several errors of sense: A gets the illness remark and the closing resemblance right but misreads the wicked companions and the pledge to forsake sin, while B gets those two right but misreads the captives, the illness remark and the final line."}

{"A": {"fidelity": 4, "omitted": ["'u ꝑel' (the Person) in 'the Person of the Son of God' (rendered only as 'The Son of God')", "'and all things' as things that were created ('y tulacal bahũ baal' with 'c Zihzalexe') is dropped from the comparison", "'Ɔocebali' (finally) at the start of the last paragraph"], "added": ["\"One day\""], "mistranslated": ["paibentzil, 'it is very necessary that we believe' -> 'Believe very firmly'", "Zihzah, 'were not created as you/we were created' -> 'were not born as you were born'", "'tulacal bahũ baal' belongs with the creatures that were created -> moved to 'Before all things, before heaven and earth existed'"]}, "B": {"fidelity": 3, "omitted": [], "added": ["\"and it stops moving as well\"", "<gloss>Henry of Ghent</gloss> and the note naming Enrique Gran as Henricus Gandavensis is probably false; Enrique Gran is more likely Heinrich Gran, the printer of the Speculum exemplorum"], "mistranslated": ["'â hanonexe' (your eating / what you consume) -> 'when we sleep'", "'bai û peec xan heklae' (so it moves too) -> 'and it stops moving as well'", "'ma uchac û tabli' (cannot be deceived) -> 'it cannot deceive because He is supremely clear to all things'"]}, "better": "A", "comment": "Both translations cover the whole page, but B gets the 'paibentzil' and 'created' passages right while A slips there, and B adds a probably false Henry of Ghent identification plus a 'sleep' reading not in the source, so A comes out slightly ahead."}

{"A": {"fidelity": 4, "omitted": ["'bin c yacunteex' (whom we shall love), said of the Holy Spirit at the start", "'uꝑel' (only) in 'uꝑel mehen Dioz', the only Son of God"], "added": [], "mistranslated": ["rhetorical question 'Baxi ú nucul ta tuculeex' (what is the answer in your thinking: why do men live in darkness?) -> rendered as 'What do you think?' followed by plain statements", "'caat emi' (then descended) -> 'wished to come down'"]}, "B": {"fidelity": 5, "omitted": [], "added": [], "mistranslated": []}, "better": "B", "comment": "B is complete and keeps the opening question and 'only Son', while A leaves out 'whom we shall love' and 'only' and loosens the opening question."}

{"A": {"fidelity": 2, "omitted": [], "added": ["shone"], "mistranslated": ["yokol ú noh celembal (above his great youthful form) -> \"upon his shoulder\"", "ú yabal Zakcil hebixten (so full of misery as I am) -> \"with such great whiteness as this\"", "ú alabolal ah Zatalob (hope of the lost) -> \"praise of the lost\"", "ɔecec yalil in uich ... uchic in uoktic yn Keban (these few tears from my eyes with which I weep for my sin) -> \"this mark of blood on my face, which I received for my sin\"", "chich ú muKob ú Kabilob toh pulKeban (the strength of the hands of confession) -> \"the tears of true confession have very great strength\"", "caix hach Zahbentzil (though it was very fearsome) -> \"they are greatly to be revered\""]}, "B": {"fidelity": 4, "omitted": [], "added": [], "mistranslated": ["tuyilah y ú yah ɔaiatzilich (the sick man saw him and his merciful face) -> \"looked upon him with tender mercy\" (the subject is reversed)", "ú yich (his face) -> \"the anger\""]}, "better": "B", "comment": "Both translations cover the whole page, but A gets several key passages wrong (the shoulder, the whiteness, the blood mark, tears instead of hands, revered instead of fearsome), while B follows the source closely with only small slips."}

{"A": {"fidelity": 2, "omitted": ["'the hands hang down, the eyes close' (le kaƀóob cú luƀulóob, le pacatóob cú kalicuƀaóob)", "'even if it cost much pain and many days' (cá anac ú toholtic yaƀalóob yailóob iix kinilé)"], "added": ["\"the glances of grace turned toward it\"", "\"which now give bad example\""], "mistranslated": ["the hands that drop, the eyes that close -> \"the inspirations that come to it, the glances of grace\"", "out of habit they turn their backs on prayers and devotions -> \"if out of habit it is asked to repeat its prayers at their proper times\"", "deeds that give off a foul stench (kakaz ƀoc) -> \"give bad example\"", "each day shame is born -> \"Sins are taken up, and shamelessness with them\"", "the worms of a corrupt life teem -> \"The pleasures of a wicked life increase\"", "a mockery of a Christian (cheh) -> \"a dry trunk of a Christian\"", "nothing is seen that shows signs of the former beauty -> \"Nothing else is seen in it but traces of the former beauty\"", "unless they quickly call on Jesus Christ, as the synagogue ruler did -> \"unless Jesus Christ had called it at the very beginning, as he did for the ruler\"", "broke an arm -> \"received a wound\"", "how much pain and difficulty the cure will take -> \"how much more pain the wound brings, and how pitiful the wound becomes\"", "see whether custom/experience does not confirm it: rendered correctly, but 'Tu zeƀlacil' (immediately) -> \"At the beginning\" is a small slip"]}, "B": {"fidelity": 4, "omitted": [], "added": [], "mistranslated": ["see whether custom/experience itself does not confirm it -> \"See now whether, if it is constantly delayed, it does not settle\"", "out of habit (napzah) -> \"because of neglect\"", "Let us confirm (C heɔcuntéex) is rendered well; 'olmail' (difficult) is handled properly, but 'thanksgiving prayers' is a loose rendering of niƀolalóob payalchióob"]}, "better": "B", "comment": "B tracks the Maya closely (hands and eyes, stench, worms, mockery, the broken arm and gangrene) with only a mistranslated opening sentence, while A repeatedly makes up or reverses the sense, including who calls on Christ and what the former beauty shows."}

{"A": {"fidelity": 3, "omitted": ["'á zàat-zahul' (your forgiveness) in 'necessary for your forgiveness of us sinners' is dropped; it is rendered only as 'for us sinners'"], "added": [], "mistranslated": ["hakobilóob caputcuxtalóob (marvellous restorations to life) -> 'many sinners return to life'", "hele (today) -> 'then'", "cħa y á yuchucil zinil kab (stretch forth your powerful hand) -> 'bring your power of forgiveness'", "má unchacóob ú helel (that they have no rest) -> 'they do not delay their change'", "cú nahmaticóob humpel hach pelelil ɔá uol (they deserve very earnest attention) -> 'bring on a very great dread in the heart'"]}, "B": {"fidelity": 4, "omitted": [], "added": [], "mistranslated": ["ti zebchilah is rendered 'with urgency' and zebchitic as 'swiftly awaken'; the sense of foretelling or prophecy may be lost (uncertain)", "cá xocicéex (that is read to you / you hear read) -> 'that you read' (slight)"]}, "better": "B", "comment": "B correctly renders the outstretched hand, the 'no rest until they seek you' clause, the marvellous restorations and the 'deserves attention' sentence, all of which A gets wrong."}

{"A": {"fidelity": 2, "omitted": ["the point that the remedy for sin must be applied at once (kaƀet ú ɔáƀal ... le ɔác ti keƀan)", "the contrast of weakness against obstinacy, violent temptation against deliberate contempt, and frailty against free will, which A replaces with an unclear, approximate rendering", "'xmá olil iix makolal' (lukewarmness and sloth)"], "added": ["\"because he wishes his great goodness and mercy to be honored\"", "\"He shows great power in his testing, and gives the means to hold back\""], "mistranslated": ["it is not only for the sinner's sake that the remedy must be applied at once -> the sinner's rising becomes harder the longer the fall lasts", "when Christ sees we fall easily and call on him promptly, he recognizes weakness rather than obstinacy -> he calls you at once because he wishes his goodness to be honored", "pushes aside the hand God extends to deliver him -> hinders the good that God wished to do", "losing the love of his God -> lost the strength of his God", "so much the more unworthy we make ourselves before Him -> so many times you fail to do what is right toward him", "so many extended hands -> so many further favors", "if you will ask for it -> if you will only receive them", "the coldness and sloth with which you call on the Pardoner -> when He calls you to forgiveness without being heeded"]}, "B": {"fidelity": 4, "omitted": [], "added": [], "mistranslated": ["'má c payben xancunticéexi' is rendered as a plain 'we must not delay' (small nuance)", "'yáaƀ cóomil' (a short or brief thing) -> 'a brief stumble' (slightly free)"]}, "better": "B", "comment": "B follows the source's argument closely throughout, while A misreads the opening reasoning, admits a passage it cannot translate, and mistranslates several later clauses."}

{"A": {"fidelity": 2, "omitted": ["'zebchilah' (hastily) in 'I do not wish to say hastily'", "'naklic' (the Samaritan woman sitting/resting at the well)", "the sense of the heart trembling in terror ('uol hach heɔáan cú cilba')"], "added": ["\"as a thing most certainly to be seen\"", "\"as the prophecy says\""], "mistranslated": ["the heart, greatly terrified, trembles and the blood curdles -> 'as a thing most certainly to be seen, and blood will flow'", "because of this he punishes us with many miseries (tzecultóon) -> 'it leads us astray, and the many evils … foretell it'", "Lord and lover (ah yacunah) -> 'Strengthener'", "asking of your son (á ual) the gifts of grace -> 'I ask you for the help of grace'", "that they may answer me (núuctenóob) from the heart -> 'that they may receive it in their hearts'", "how perfect (chucáanil) are his words -> 'though his words are few'", "in all their great miseries (nummia hach yaé) -> 'in all his many mercies'", "good ways (tibilbeilóob) and wondrous teachings -> 'reproaches and harsh prophecies'", "his perfections (chucáanilóob) -> 'those severe things'", "in his writing (ɔilib) -> 'in his holiness'"]}, "B": {"fidelity": 4, "omitted": [], "added": [], "mistranslated": ["when you (c ilicéex) see … flee ye (puɔcóonéx) -> 'when we happen to see … let us flee'", "that we must not fail to recognize (má c paymaéex kaholticéex) -> 'whom we do not first recognize'", "'mà halili tioklal leti nucul' rendered loosely as 'not only in that teaching'"]}, "better": "B", "comment": "B follows the Maya closely in most places (terror and trembling, punishment by afflictions, asking of the Virgin's son, perfect words, good ways, writing), while A gets many key words wrong and in several places reverses the sense."}

{"A": {"fidelity": 4, "omitted": [], "added": [], "mistranslated": ["tzicbenil (respect/honour) is rendered correctly as 'respect', but 'how should they act?' slightly expands the bare 'bic?' (minor)", "hebic y le ú mehentzilóob Diosé (as with the children of God, i.e. as brothers/God's children) -> 'Just as God acts toward His children'", "ti laóobé (in them) -> 'through them' (minor)"]}, "B": {"fidelity": 2, "omitted": ["the negation in 'uaix ma táan ú ɔabal antahul' (or NOT giving help) is dropped"], "added": ["\"Is there any obligation toward others to keep them from death?\" (not in the source; this replaces the actual question)"], "mistranslated": ["tzicbenil (respect/honour) -> 'peace'", "yuntzilóob y le palilóob (masters and servants) -> 'fathers with their children'", "palilóob y le yumtzilóob (servants and masters) -> 'children with their fathers'", "hebic y le ú mehentzilóob Diosé (as with the children of God) -> 'As God with his children'", "báax cú uetħic chucanil (what does it fully forbid) -> 'what does ... require'", "Yan ú chucanil ... ú yánalóob nuculóob ti cimzah (are there other ways belonging to killing?) -> 'Is there any obligation toward others to keep them from death?'", "ɔabal kazil ɔilib (giving bad example/scandal) -> 'giving good counsel' (the note justifying this is false)", "uaix ma táan ú ɔabal antahul (or not giving help) -> 'or by giving help'"]}, "better": "A", "comment": "A follows the Maya closely with only small slips, but B misreads masters/servants as fathers/children, changes the question about other ways of killing, and turns 'bad example' and 'not helping' into their opposites."}

{"A": {"fidelity": 2, "omitted": ["ah ƀolóob (the sellers who were stationed there)"], "added": ["my children"], "mistranslated": ["Ilaéex (see ye) -> 'You know well'", "tamanóob (sheep), mehen uacxóob (young oxen) -> 'oxen, little sheep' (animals swapped)", "tancaƀ (out into the courtyard) -> 'out of the temple'", "they made a house of buying and selling of what was only meant as a house of prayer -> 'making the house of prayer a house of selling and buying, which is only fit to be called a den of thieves'", "cambezah ti c nuculil cuxtaléex (apply this teaching to our way of life) -> 'bring to mind the evils of our Christian life'", "ti hach nohochil hatzul (in the greater part of) your churches -> 'of very great moment'", "Cóonéex tioklal hatzulilóob (let us go part by part) -> 'Listen, for they are grave matters'"]}, "B": {"fidelity": 3, "omitted": [], "added": [], "mistranslated": ["Ahzáat-zahuléex (you sinners, vocative) -> 'our Ahzáat-zah (Savior)'", "In heláancuntah ƀahun (remember now) -> 'How ... changed this'", "Ahzáat-zah zipiléex (you sinners) -> 'our Forgiver of sins acted thus'", "napzah uaiix tá kaholticéex (be moved, or come to recognize it) -> 'serve to correct what you already recognize' (loose)"]}, "better": "B", "comment": "B gets the animals, the courtyard, the house-of-prayer clause, the 'greater part' phrase and the closing 'by parts' right, but wrongly reads the vocative 'sinners' as a title of Christ, while A handles 'sinners' correctly but makes more errors of sense, including the closing line."}

{"A": {"fidelity": 3, "omitted": [], "added": [], "mistranslated": ["Mayli cú nahaltic (rather he gains merit) -> \"No, if he does not take pleasure in them\"", "le nuculóob kebané (the occasions/instruments of sin) -> \"the sinful thoughts\""]}, "B": {"fidelity": 4, "omitted": [], "added": [], "mistranslated": ["c meyahtbaóob (our mortifications/penances) -> \"our pious devotions\"", "le xmá tiblil (idleness/disorderliness, Ripalda's 'ociosidad') -> \"Bad conduct\"", "ti ú yalahul (with his will) -> \"with full consent\" (slight overstatement)"]}, "better": "B", "comment": "B gets the key answer right ('rather he gains merit, if he removes the occasions of sin'), while A turns it into a different condition about not taking pleasure; A is more accurate on 'penance' and 'idleness'."}

{"A": {"fidelity": 3, "omitted": [], "added": ["or the harm that they did", "<note>The answer breaks off at \"cú tuz,\" \"who lies,\" and appears incomplete in the printed text.</note> (false: 'cú tuz' is a complete clause, only missing its final stop)"], "mistranslated": ["bin ɔocanacti ú tohpultic ú keban (will it be enough to confess his sin?) -> will one enter into the forgiveness of their sin", "le báax ú ꝑaxmá ti ú comiló (what he owes to its owner) -> what they have taken from their neighbor", "uaix lay nucul ti cá ú láak ú ment ló (or gives the means/occasion for another to do it) -> or who causes another to do it", "mix cú yubicóob x má xulilóob (nor listens to such things endlessly/idly) -> nor listen to them when they are untrue", "lobóob yanaláob (ill of others) -> evil of the deeds of their neighbors"]}, "B": {"fidelity": 4, "omitted": [], "added": ["vain words", "worldly"], "mistranslated": ["mix cú yubicóob x má xulilóob (nor listens to them without end) -> nor listens to endless vain words (adds 'vain words')"]}, "better": "B", "comment": "B correctly reads the restitution exchange as 'is it enough to confess his sin… if he does not pay what he owes to its owner', which matches Ripalda, while A misreads tohpultic and ꝑaxmá and adds a misleading note that the text is incomplete."}

{"A": {"fidelity": 4, "omitted": [], "added": ["the one we call the Holy Father", "for our sins"], "mistranslated": ["c paymá tulul tzic (to whom we give full reverence/obedience) -> 'the one we call the Holy Father'", "Bahun ti ú yabal misa (since Mass is mentioned) -> 'Since you are told to hear Mass'", "cú mentáal ti Cristo (made of/by Christ) -> 'made to Christ'"]}, "B": {"fidelity": 5, "omitted": [], "added": [], "mistranslated": ["zut-zah yacunahóob (benefits/favours returned) -> 'in return of love' (slightly loose)"]}, "better": "B", "comment": "B follows the Maya closely, especially for 'c paymá tulul tzic', while A replaces that phrase with an invented 'Holy Father' rendering and adds a few small glosses taken from the Spanish model rather than from this page."}

{"A": {"fidelity": 4, "omitted": [], "added": [], "mistranslated": ["tipáan zazilcuntic ('to make clearer / illuminate better') -> 'may be kept better' (follows Ripalda's Spanish rather than the Maya verb)", "ú nohpolil obispo cú mektanticé ('its great head bishop, who governs it') -> 'by the one who is the great head bishop' (slightly garbled structure, sense mostly preserved)"]}, "B": {"fidelity": 3, "omitted": ["tu beil tibilil / ú yanal tioklal: the 'for one's living / station' sense of the question is reduced", "y pelelil ('special') in the question about commandments on lust and riches"], "added": ["'of the Law' (in 'commandments of the Law of God')"], "mistranslated": ["Is it a sin to desire riches for one's living/station in a proper way -> 'Is it a sin to desire to have riches, other than for a good purpose?' (reverses the question's sense)", "Why are there special commandments about these desires -> 'Why are the desires... forbidden by these commandments?'", "because their thoughts and desires can become evil -> 'from them arise evil thoughts and evil inclinations'"]}, "better": "A", "comment": "A follows the Maya questions closely, with one slip on zazilcuntic, while B changes the sense of the first question, leaves out 'special' and adds 'Law', though B renders zazilcuntic ('clearer') more accurately."}

{"A": {"fidelity": 2, "omitted": [], "added": ["he shall take patience", "it is greatly to be honored"], "mistranslated": ["ru coꜭhih yi ru nima hoyeuaxic, ru vaꜭh (the Father applies the great pardon before him) -> 'he shall take patience, and it is greatly to be honored, its presence'", "ki ti vagaxah ꜭhipe ru ꜭhoh mil vae (what is needed for this benefit/pardon to come) -> 'what you should hear concerning its proper benefit'", "ah ghumum, ah ꜫatat gux, ah biꜯ (humbled, contrite-hearted, sorrowful penitents) -> 'proud, hard-hearted, or indeed songsters, merrymakers'", "ah ahil ꜭhiroꜫexic ronohel kamac (desiring to declare all our sins) -> 'weeping over all our sins'", "tan ti giꜯ ruçaꜭh Padre Saçerdote (being before the face of the Father Priest) -> 'while the Father Priest is giving absolution'", "ha ahoxel ti ka ban penitençia (only then do we do penance) -> 'it is fitting that we do penance'"]}, "B": {"fidelity": 4, "omitted": [], "added": [], "mistranslated": ["ꜭhibiꜯ (with weeping/song, uncertain) -> 'with sorrow' (tentative)", "tan ti giꜯ ruçaꜭh (being in the presence of) -> 'wanting to declare ... before' (a little loose)"]}, "better": "B", "comment": "B gives the sense of the passage on the pardon granted through the Father and the dispositions needed for confession, while A turns the opening and the list of penitent dispositions into nonsense such as 'proud, hard-hearted, songsters, merrymakers'."}

{"A": {"fidelity": 3, "omitted": [], "added": [], "mistranslated": ["ru ghumumibal 'its groaning/sighing' -> 'the crushing'", "utz ta ka banom chic ka Confesion, xax ti ka ban vi ka penitencia 'even if we have made our confession well, we must still do our penance' -> 'If we have made our Confesion well, only then do we truly perform our penitencia'", "xa ha ti hal bex, ti gex va chi bex... chi ru pokonariçabal 'only it is commuted/exchanged, the eternal death, into its suffering and torment' -> 'it will be changed and taken away, this eternal death, with its punishment and its misery' (loses the sense of commuting eternal death into temporal punishment)"]}, "B": {"fidelity": 4, "omitted": [], "added": [], "mistranslated": ["paru chij 'in its hands/from it' -> 'from the burning heat' (uncertain reading)"]}, "better": "B", "comment": "B correctly renders the concessive sense that penance must still be done after confession and the commuting of eternal death into temporal punishment, which A gets wrong in both places."}

{"A": {"fidelity": 3, "omitted": ["ra hilaxic paru vi (its being read over him) in the first clause", "chi vꜯiriçabal (absolution) in 'chiri ga tu ni macochih vi vinak chi vꜯiriçabal vi chin chiru bula', which A renders as 'makes use of'", "tok ruꜯiriçax (when he is absolved) near the end, which A renders as 'makes use of this Bull'"], "added": ["when a person is gravely ill"], "mistranslated": ["there the person receives absolution through the Bull -> Then also, when a person is gravely ill, he makes use of this Bull", "its being read over him and its absolution by the Father take effect -> the absolution is fittingly granted to him, as the Father applies it", "it is read over him (tahilax paru vi) -> it is applied to him", "when he is absolved through the Bull -> when he makes use of this Bull"]}, "B": {"fidelity": 3, "omitted": [], "added": ["or in the hospital"], "mistranslated": ["pa chavomariçabal hay (in the house of cleansing/purification, i.e. Purgatory) -> or in the hospital", "chupam ru ꜫitahic hun vinak (at a person's dying/final hour, tentative) -> in visiting a person"]}, "better": "B", "comment": "B follows the structure of the Kaqchikel more closely, including the reading over the person and the absolution, though it wrongly makes the gloss on Purgatory 'the hospital'; A swaps receiving absolution for 'gravely ill' and blurs the reading and absolution clauses."}

{"A": {"fidelity": 4, "omitted": [], "added": ["our fasting", "and our mortification"], "mistranslated": ["ruꜫatbal (finishing or cancelling of the debt) -> 'the gift'", "we did not care to do good works / the days for making satisfaction (ma ni ga xka gux laah rubanic ... ꜫomibal kij) -> 'penance, our fasting and our mortification'"]}, "B": {"fidelity": 2, "omitted": ["ruꜫat bal reading is kept but the concessive 'however great a person's sin may be' (chica nihrach ça chic rumac hun vinak) is lost"], "added": ["is immediately lightened", "wasting their days instead of"], "mistranslated": ["ꜭhavomariçabal hay (house of cleansing/washing) -> 'house of torment'", "chica nihrach ça chic rumac hun vinak riru tohel rumac (however great a person's sin, once its payment is made) -> 'the punishment for a person's sins is immediately lightened'", "ti be ta ru toho (he will not go to pay it) -> 'which they would otherwise have gone to pay'", "haga tan ti gamon vi (if he should then die) -> 'And it is now received from this'", "yiriçabal (end of 'cleansing', running into Purgatorio) -> 'and the purification of Purgatorio'"]}, "better": "A", "comment": "A gets the cleansing gloss, the 'however great the sin' clause and the closing 'if he should die' right, with only some guessing in the penance list; B mistranslates the purgatory term, the main clause about sin and the final clause."}

{"A": {"fidelity": 4, "omitted": [], "added": [], "mistranslated": ["ꜫobal (likely the end of a word carried over from the previous page, e.g. 'help') -> 'a ransom'", "tan tihath, tantiya ꜭhivi (second-person: you take it, you give for it) -> 'It is currently offered and granted to them'", "pahuley, pahutaꜩ: the rendering 'pit, abyss' is uncertain"]}, "B": {"fidelity": 3, "omitted": ["caꜭhibal mac (remission of sins) is not translated"], "added": ["'which are given'"], "mistranslated": ["ca ca huna / cay ꜭhihuna (two years, every two years) -> 'each year', 'year by year', 'the year'", "pahuley, pahutaꜩ: the rendering 'in the fire, in the burning' is uncertain"]}, "better": "A", "comment": "A is complete and gets the two-year term right, while B leaves out 'remission of sins' and turns the two-year validity of the Bull into an annual one, though B handles the opening 'help and comfort' and the second-person address better."}
